card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits such as 0, 5 or 6 that continue a number already begun, like the 0 in 10 or the 5 in 15, mostly before units of time such as seconds or years.

modes.label: Second digit of a number
modes.description: A digit following a leading 1 or 2 in a two-digit count of seconds or years.

modes.label: Digit in a range or decimal
modes.description: The last digit of a range end or a decimal in a size or time.

card.writes: It suppresses the word half and similar tokens, so the model avoids half-type continuations after a number.
card.plain: It lights up on the second digit of a number like 10 or 15 and steers away from saying half.
